mapper.select: select c1.C_Name as cName, c1.C_Name_History as cNameHistory, c1.C_Abbreviation as cAbbName, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Name_History as pNameHistory, pro.P_Code as pCode, sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Code as secCode, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Audit_Budget mn left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = mn.Ab_Create_Cid left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID = mn.Ab_Id where mn.Sec_Id = #{secId} and mn.Ab_State!=3

select f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, c1.C_Name as cName, c1.C_Name_History as cNameHistory, c1.C_Abbreviation as cAbbName, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Name_History as pNameHistory, pro.P_Code as pCode, sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Code as secCode, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, mn.* from Audit_Budget mn left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = mn.Ab_Create_Cid left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID = mn.Ab_Id where mn.Ab_Id = #{abId}
